newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian tin, nickel prices fall on weak world trends.
newsitem.headline: Indian tin, nickel prices fall on weak world trends.

text.p: Indian nickel and tin prices on Tuesday fell while other base metals were steady, dealers said.
Nickel and tin extended losses on weak world market trends which prompted fresh selling while industrial buying was at a low ebb.
Nickel fell by 200 rupees to 34,500 rupees per quintal after losing 100 rupees on Monday while tin fell by 200 rupees to 29,800 rupees per quintal, after losing 100 rupees on Monday.
Copper was steady at 13,850 rupees per quintal, zinc at 8,150 rupees and lead at 4,100 rupees per quintal.
"We are awaiting an announcement of selling prices by state-owned agencies for July," a dealer said.
"These agencies may hike prices of copper and zinc by 1,500/2,000 rupees per tonne," a dealer said.
